purpose: Freeze an outcome-free external confirmation measurement design for the calibrated Task15J P3/P5 models.

prohibited: changing the confirmation pair set after measurement
measurement_and_scoring.unsupported_descriptor_disposition: Pairs outside the frozen P3/P5 descriptor taxonomy are reported and excluded before any outcome label is opened.

primary_confirmation_analysis.interval: two-sided 95% dyadic cluster-robust sandwich interval using physical image IDs as dyad members
primary_confirmation_analysis.success_rule: The lower endpoint of the frozen dyadic cluster-robust interval is greater than 0.005.

claim_boundary: This contract authorizes measurement design only. It does not open confirmation labels or establish P5 superiority, external performance, deployment utility, identity accuracy, or project completion.
